data.title: 迦摩 · 茶馆观察人间
data.description: 现世的露天咖啡馆，她戴着遮阳帽伪装成普通美女，支着下巴观察情侣互动；嘴里嘀咕着「无聊」「堕落吧」，吸管却把饮料喝得见了底。
data.action: 现世的露天咖啡馆，她戴着遮阳帽伪装成普通美女，支着下巴观察情侣互动
data.promptProse: Beneath her sunhat at the outdoor cafe, Kama supports her chin with one hand and idly rotates the straw in a nearly empty drink with the other. Lavender blouse, long cream skirt and small gold earrings keep the disguise ordinary as red eyes observe the passing street. The medium view includes a saucer beside the glass. Dappled afternoon light patterns the tabletop and brim, with soft shade over her increasingly amused expression.
